external_potential.description: switch on for external gravitational potential.

rotation.description: switch on to evolve the azimuthal velocity (requires 'cylindrical' geometry).

radiation.description: switch on for radiation transport. Without hydro, the radiation exchanges energy with a static material (and needs a fixed number of timesteps).

length.description: size of the code unit of length, in cm.

mass.description: size of the code unit of mass, in g.

time.description: size of the code unit of time, in s.

temperature.description: size of the code unit of temperature, in K.

speed_of_light.description: set the speed of light directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

gravitational_constant.description: set the gravitational constant directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

planck_constant.description: set the Planck constant directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

boltzmann_constant.description: set the Boltzmann constant directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

proton_mass.description: set the proton mass directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

radiation_constant.description: set the radiation constant a_r directly, in code units. null derives it from the units.

origin.description: lower corner of the domain. For 'cylindrical' geometry a non-zero origin[0] gives an annulus, whose inner boundary is a wall rather than the symmetry axis.

boundary_condition.description: options: 'periodic', 'reflective', 'outflow', 'wall', 'driven', 'axis' (per dimension). 'wall' is a perfectly conducting wall (the same as 'reflective' for pure hydro). 'driven' takes its ghost cells from sim.driven_boundary(state, axis). 'axis' places the cylindrical axis at R=0 and a reflecting wall at R=box_size[0]; it is required for, and only valid with, 'cylindrical' geometry. With magnetic=True, 'reflective' is not supported.

num_timesteps.description: set to a positive value to fix the number of (equi-spaced) timesteps.

mean_molecular_weight.description: mean molecular weight mu: the gas temperature is T = mu m_p P / (k_B rho).

table_path.description: path to tabular EOS data file for 'tabular' gas.

slope_limiting.description: switch on to use slope limiting.

flux_limiter.description: flux limiter of the 'diffusion' method. options: 'levermore_pomraning', 'larsen', 'max', 'none' (plain diffusion).

num_polar.description: number of polar angles of the discrete ordinates (even).

num_azimuthal.description: number of azimuthal angles of the discrete ordinates, over half a circle (even).

group_edges.description: interior boundaries h nu / k_B of the frequency groups, in temperature units. Empty for grey radiation.

absorption.description: Rosseland mean absorption opacity kappa_a (per unit mass), a number or one per frequency group.

planck.description: Planck mean absorption opacity kappa_p (per unit mass), a number or one per frequency group. null takes the absorption opacity.

tau_factor.description: scales the optical depth per cell that switches the transport from upwind to diffusive.

tol.description: tolerance of the implicit radiation solve: it stops once its last update of the intensities is this fraction of their change over the step.

gmres_restart.description: number of Krylov vectors kept by GMRES between restarts; more speeds up streaming-dominated problems, at the cost of memory.

max_iterations.description: maximum number of Newton (gmres) or Jacobi iterations per radiation solve.

little_h.description: Hubble parameter little h (H_0 = 100 h km/s/Mpc).
